text: Behind this wall... are Gog and Magog.
A people begged Dhul-Qarnayn: Gog and Magog are spreading corruption in the land. Build a barrier between us and them.
He said: bring me sheets of iron. Blow on it... until it became like fire. Then he poured molten copper over it.
And they could not climb over it... nor dig through it.
But he said: when the promise of my Lord comes, He will make it level. And the promise of my Lord is true.
